Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to common questions about selling your house for cash to TurnedKey Properties.

How much will you pay for my house?

Fair market offers based on condition, location, and recent comparable sales. Competitive and transparent — no hidden deductions.

Are there any fees or commissions?

None. No fees, commissions, or closing costs. The offer is what you receive at closing.

How fast can you close?

As little as 7 days, or 30–90 days if you need more time.

Do I need to make repairs?

No — we buy as-is, from cosmetic issues to major structural damage.

What if I still owe on my mortgage?

We pay it off at closing; you keep the remaining equity.

Is this legitimate?

Yes — we have purchased 92 homes and close through licensed title companies and attorneys.

Do you buy in all 50 states?

Yes, nationwide.

What happens after I submit my information?

We contact you within 24 hours, schedule a walkthrough, and present a no-obligation cash offer.
